description:
1296Wh Long-Range Battery for All-Day Adventures
The high-capacity 48V 27Ah (1296Wh) battery lets you travel 140–160 km on a single charge, perfect for long commutes, countryside trips, or full-day errands. An intelligent BMS monitors each cell in real time, preventing overcharge, deep discharge, and overheating – boosting safety and extending service life. A built?in lock deters theft, while APP and NFC unlock let you power on and manage PAS, lights, and ride data without keys – for effortless, secure starts.

Powerful 48V 80Nm Motor with Torque Sensor
Equipped with a 48V motor delivering 80Nm of torque, plus a built?in torque sensor that reads your pedaling force in real time, this ebike offers smooth, surge?free acceleration and natural assistance – no jerky starts, no wasted energy. The 25 km/h assist speed, Shimano 7?speed gearing, and 6 km/h walking mode make city commutes and weekend rides easier and more enjoyable – always within legal limits.

20×4.0" Puncture-Resistant Fat Tyres for Any Terrain

Take on city streets, gravel paths, and light off-road trails with confidence. The 20×4.0 puncture-resistant fat tyres and lockable front suspension fork deliver stability, comfort, and traction across all terrains—ideal for riders who need a versatile ebike for both commuting and adventure.

Step-Through Frame with Front & Rear Cargo Baskets

The comfortable low-step frame makes mounting and dismounting easy, especially when carrying cargo. Equipped with a robust front basket (dimensions: 31.5×33×14?cm) capable of holding up to 25 kg, and an extra-large rear basket (dimensions: 53.5×40.5×11?cm) offering a load capacity of up to 35 kg, the bicycle transforms into a full-fledged cargo e-bike—perfect for large shopping trips, carrying school materials, delivery services, or transporting work supplies.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes & TUV-Certified Safety

Stay safe in all weather with hydraulic disc brakes that deliver precise, responsive stopping power. A bright front headlight, rear tail light, and full TüV-certified build ensure dependable safety and quality wherever your journey takes you—day or night.
